name: Sildenafil
executiveSummary: PDE-5 inhibitor. Adult PAH (Revatio): **20 mg PO every 8 h**. Pediatric PHT: **0.5–1 mg/kg/dose every 6–8 h** (usual max **20 mg**/dose; ceiling **~4 mg/kg/day**). Specialist only. Not with nitrates.
indications:
## Indications

- Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) / PHT crises in pediatric/neonatal ICU per protocol.
- Erectile dysfunction: **different dose** (25–100 mg as needed) — do not mix with PAH regimen.

## Precautions

- **Contraindicated with nitrates / riociguat** (severe hypotension).
- Hypotension, headache, flushing, visual changes.
- Historical FDA pediatric warning — restricted use.

> IV (0.8 mg/mL imported) only if available and with cardiology.

adulto.dose: PAH: **20 mg PO every 8 h**. ED: **25–100 mg** 30–60 min before (max 1/day) — different indication.
adulto.notes: Adjust in severe liver disease / CYP3A4 comeds.

pediatrico.presentation: Tabs 50 mg; compounded 2 mg/mL; IV ampoule 0.8 mg/mL (imported).
pediatrico.dose: PHT: start **0.5–1 mg/kg/dose every 6–8 h**; maintenance **0.25–1 mg/kg**; usual max **20 mg**/dose and **~4 mg/kg/day**.

stability:
## Stability

- Store in original container per label.
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Headache, flushing, dyspepsia, nasal congestion, abnormal vision, hypotension; rarely priapism.
